system:
You write triage summaries of companies for a team that vets suppliers and project partners. The reader has about 30 seconds and must decide whether the company deserves a closer look.

Rules:
1. Use ONLY the facts provided. Never calculate, estimate or add outside knowledge. Copy figures exactly as written.
2. Lead with what matters most: the HIGH signals first, then MEDIUM. Mention INFO signals only if they add useful context.
3. If financial statements are missing, say so plainly. Never imply figures that are not provided.
4. State which financial year the latest figures are from, because they may be out of date.
5. Court cases that are not listed under the signals are settled, withdrawn, dismissed, or brought by the company itself. Do not present them as concerns.
6. Be neutral and factual. Do not recommend for or against doing business with the company.
7. 70 to 110 words. Plain Markdown, no headings.
prompt:
Write the summary for this company.

Structure: one opening sentence saying what the company is (name, industry, state, year incorporated), then the most important risks and facts, with the most serious first. If there are no significant signals, say so and give the headline financial position instead.

Company: Everbright Prima Homestay Sdn. Bhd. (SYN-001389)
Industry: Hospitality | State: Selangor | Status: Active
Business: Boutique hotel in Penang
Incorporated: 2013-12-12 | Share capital: RM100,000
Board: 5 director(s); 1 appointed in the 12 months to 31 Dec 2025
Largest shareholder: 87.8% (also a director)
Financial years available: FY2022, FY2023, FY2024 (latest year end 2024-09-30)
FY2022: revenue RM30.84m, profit after tax RM1.35m, equity RM13.87m, operating cash flow RM3.76m, audit: Unqualified
FY2023: revenue RM42.06m, profit after tax RM2.79m, equity RM15.83m, operating cash flow RM4.36m, audit: Unqualified
FY2024: revenue RM59.06m, profit after tax RM4.01m, equity RM18.63m, operating cash flow RM7.64m, audit: Unqualified
Court cases: 8 total (8 as defendant, 0 as plaintiff); open cases against company: 3
Risk and context signals (computed, already verified):
- [MEDIUM] 3 open case(s) against the company (pending or judgment entered), claims totalling RM731,700, equal to 4% of equity (RM18.63m).
- [INFO] One shareholder holds 87.8% of the company.
response:
Everbright Prima Homestay Sdn. Bhd. is a hospitality company in Selangor incorporated on 2013-12-12 that operates a boutique hotel in Penang. 

The company presents a medium signal of 3 open cases against it as a defendant, with claims totaling RM731,700, which equals 4% of its FY2024 equity. An info signal notes that a single shareholder holds 87.8% of the company. 

For the latest financial year ending 2024-09-30 (FY2024), the company reported revenue of RM59.06m, profit after tax of RM4.01m, equity of RM18.63m, operating cash flow of RM7.64m, and an unqualified audit.
